card.name: Opinionated claims of contrast or reversal
card.fires_on: The word that completes a forceful contrast or ideological claim in opinion writing, such as 'opposite', 'true' before a group name, 'alone', or 'supremacy'. It often sits just before a colon, comma, or period that finishes the claim.

modes.label: Opposite / reverse
modes.description: The word 'opposite' or its parts in a claim that results are the reverse of what was promised.

modes.label: Ideological claim endings
modes.description: A noun or punctuation mark closing a strong polemical statement about a movement or system.
